badgeHtmlPattern: Made with Unbounce (branded footer on free/trial pages; exact markup UNVERIFIED)
htmlSignatures: div#lp-pom-root with class "lp-element lp-pom-root" (absolute-positioned root container present on every Classic-Builder page) — CONFIRMED on 3 independent real pages
data-page-type attribute (observed values: main, main_desktop, main_mobile) — CONFIRMED
ub:clientsidedynamic, data-vimeo-id, data-params — present in the Unbounce page.js bundle (concept-confirmed; not on every static export)
notes:
Detection is reliable via multiple INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED signals, verified across 3 real Unbounce Classic-Builder pages, a urlscan.io capture, and Unbounce's own community docs.

PRIMARY (confirmed) signals: (1) root container <div id="lp-pom-root" class="lp-element lp-pom-root"> present on every Classic-Builder page, with all child blocks using absolute-positioned lp-pom-* classes; (2) inline window.ub global (window.ub.page{.id,.variantId,.usedAs,.name,.url}, window.ub.form, window.ub.hooks); (3) scripts served from builder-assets.unbounce.com (stable host: /modules/lp-block, /lp-image, /lp-form, /published/*.z.js). Any ONE of these plus a cloudfront/ubembed asset host is conclusive and works on CUSTOM domains.

CORRECTION — metaGenerator: the researcher listed <meta name="generator" content="Unbounce"> as a PRIMARY signal, but it was NOT present on any of the 3 real full-HTML pages inspected. Removed (set empty). Do NOT rely on generator meta; use lp-pom-root + window.ub + builder-assets/ubembed instead.

HOSTING: default free/trial pages live at <account>.unbouncepages.com; custom root domains use *.ubpages.com; most production pages run on the customer's own CNAME'd domain — so the URL regex catches only default-hosted pages, rely on HTML signatures for custom domains.

ASSETS/CDN: images/CSS/JS are served from Amazon CloudFront AND builder-assets.unbounce.com. The cloudfront SUBDOMAIN ROTATES per account/deploy — observed across sources: d9hhrg4mnvzow (confirmed by Unbounce docs + 3 sources), d2xxq4ijfwetlm, doug1izaerwt3, d34qb8suadcc4g. The researcher's other 3 specific subdomains (d226aj4ao1t61x, d3pkntwtp2ukl5, d1txbb0uvyzsb0) were NEVER observed — removed. MATCH on the *.cloudfront.net pattern plus builder-assets.unbounce.com rather than a fixed host. Popups/sticky-bars/convertables load from <hash>.js.ubembed.com and assets.ubembed.com (confirmed).

RENDER: ssr-static — confirmed. Full positioned lp-pom-* content is present in the raw server HTML / exports; no client hydration needed.

BADGE: free/trial pages carry an Unbounce-branded footer linking to unbounce.com (branding-on-free-plan confirmed via Unbounce pricing docs), but the EXACT markup/selector could not be corroborated on the pages inspected — treat badgeHtmlPattern as approximate. Paid plans and HTML-export tools strip it, so badge absence does NOT rule out Unbounce; fall back to lp-pom-root + window.ub.

ANTI-BOT: Unbounce's own serving platform imposes none. Some customers front their custom domain with a WAF/Cloudflare, so retain per-site 403/503 handling despite the platform default of 'none'.
corrections: Verified against 3 independent real Unbounce pages (2 GitHub HTML exports, 1 gist page.js bundle), a urlscan.io capture, and Unbounce's own community docs. CONFIRMED: id=\"lp-pom-root\" root container (corrected its class from \"lp-pom-root\" to the actual \"lp-element lp-pom-root\"); lp-pom-block/button/text/image/form + lp-form-label classes; window.ub.page/.variantId/.form/.hooks globals; data-page-type / ub:clientsidedynamic / data-vimeo-id / data-params attributes; unbouncepages.com default hosting; ssr-static render.
